focusedAudit.reason: 0.7.4 carries one iOS-only fix (a TypeScript platform branch in src/zoom.ts) with fail-before/pass-after proof on master and og; full suites and hosted CI run on the candidate.

items.text: iOS: launching Tine no longer shows a red "Could not apply interface zoom." error; the interface zoom setting now applies on iOS (UI-IOS-ZOOM-TOAST-ON-LAUNCH).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog row UI-IOS-ZOOM-TOAST-ON-LAUNCH; src/zoomIos.test.ts fails on 0.7.3 and passes on the candidate.

docs.reason: Bug fix; the Guide already describes interface zoom and needs no change.

website.reason: Stable patch release; the website describes Tine generally and needs no change for this item.

blog.reason: No editorial release gate (Martin 2026-10-13); release notes live in CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub release.
